about_the_game:
Gather your friends and plunge into the depths of a handcrafted dungeon in a thrilling 4-player co-op adventure where fantasy meets horror. Venture into a labyrinthine dungeon filled with deadly traps, ancient puzzles, and lurking cryptids. Survive the perils of a classic dungeon crawl: Unearth valuable treasures, sell them in town and equip yourself with the right tools to go even deeper on your next trip down the mineshaft. But beware — every step could be your last.

About the developers:

Crunchy Bits is a team of students at MD.H Berlin, crafting their first game for a public audience. We are happy to present to you the first playable version of the game we have been working on for the last four months. Test it out and write us your feedback!

This game is in very early development but you can already get a first glimpse by getting the play test version. Remember: This is just a prototype and nowhere near being a finished game at this point. If you want a more polished experience, wait for our public demo at Next Fest in February!

content_descriptors.notes: Mild fantasy violence and depiction of blood and death.
